correctness.rationale: The path-count model reduces to a uniformly sampled r-subset S after the second independent shuffle, so Z is the sum of indicators that S avoids the incoming r-neighborhoods Bj. Single and double hypergeometric probabilities give the asserted exact variance. Row sums r force sum_{j!=k} |Bj intersect Bk|=dr(r-1), and strict second difference of f(t)=C(d-2r+t,r)/C(d,r) gives a sharp Jensen-style inequality at integral lambda. Equality forces all pair overlaps lambda, equivalently a symmetric 2-design via the incidence Gram matrix. At lambda=1 Vandermonde yields nonnegative k>=2 motif defect; plane existence gives exact minimum and a logarithmic binomial expansion yields the stated limit. Independent exact 35-subset enumeration on Fano (7,3,1) gives E Z=4/5, Var=4/25. Did not certify the infinite limit numerically.

For integral lambda=r(r-1)/(d-1) it is minimized precisely by symmetric 2-designs when available; critical plane parameters yield a nonnegative higher-intersection motif gap and limiting e^-1-(5/2)e^-2.
